x02KeyApplicability.family: Action buttons, links and native forms
x02KeyApplicability.keys: Tab/Shift+Tab traverse enabled controls. Button Enter/Space activates once; Link Enter navigates with native modifiers. Enter in a single-line form input submits; textarea Enter inserts a newline.
x02KeyApplicability.notApplicable: Space on a link is not an invented action activation; native editing keeps text/caret semantics.

x02KeyApplicability.keys: Tab/Shift+Tab entry/exit; Arrow navigation skips disabled items; Home/End focus enabled endpoints; printable typeahead finds enabled labels. Select Space opens; Enter selects; Menu Space/Enter executes once; Escape dismisses and returns opener.
x02KeyApplicability.notApplicable: Repeated display labels do not replace stringID identity; host rejected requests remain authoritative.

x02KeyApplicability.keys: ComboBox keeps Home/End/cursor keys and Space as text editing; ArrowDown advances active options and Enter commits stableID; Escape cancels/dismisses. AsyncMultiSelect keeps editable search separate from its listbox: Tab enters collection, Home/arrows focus enabled options and Space toggles selection; removing a token restores its own search focus.
x02KeyApplicability.notApplicable: Do not impose Menu-style Space selection or noneditable typeahead over text input.

x02KeyApplicability.keys: Tabs use orientation-appropriate arrows and Home/End; disabled items skipped. Automatic activation selects on focus; manual activation waits Enter/Space. Route-mode AppPageTabs remains native links with Tab/Enter.
x02KeyApplicability.notApplicable: Route links have no tabpanel/arrow-selection promise; changing composition is not an ownership-preserving live mode flip.

x02KeyApplicability.family: Checkbox, radio, switch, disclosure and removable tags
x02KeyApplicability.keys: Tab/Shift+Tab traverse enabled controls. Checkbox/Switch Space toggles; Radio arrows traverse and Space selects; Disclosure Enter/Space expands or collapses. TagGroup Delete/Backspace requests removal and preserves host rejection or surviving-item focus.
x02KeyApplicability.notApplicable: No requirement for collection typeahead or every navigation key on a single toggle.

x02KeyApplicability.keys: Navigation presentation keeps native links/buttons; command presentation uses menu interactions. Enter drills into child levels; Back restores originating full-path item, Escape unwinds command levels before outer dismissal.
x02KeyApplicability.notApplicable: Navigation mode explicitly does not emulate menu arrow keys; sliding drilldown is not a flyout contract.

x02KeyApplicability.family: Authoring page navigation, removal and Move actions
x02KeyApplicability.keys: Rename input Enter saves once; Escape cancels and returns action trigger. Host removal focuses next then previous survivor without selecting it. Keyboard Move boundaries respect accepted/rejected host order; read-only/removed page invalidates stale edits.
x02KeyApplicability.notApplicable: Routing/selection/persistence stay host-owned; no unsupported drag or generic typeahead surface invented.

x02KeyApplicability.keys: Native Tab/Shift+Tab enter/leave remembered grid entry; arrows retain row/field identity. Keyboard drag cancel and non-drag Move requests preserve source focus across accepted move/failure rollback. Focused row removal keeps focus/scroll in owning grid and sibling state independent.
x02KeyApplicability.notApplicable: No arbitrary typeahead or keyboard reorder on unsupported sorted/filtered/multipage datasets.

x02KeyApplicability.family: Editor authoring, toolbar and modal editing
x02KeyApplicability.keys: Native content editing/selection precedes formatting; keyboard toolbar actions target current selection. Escape exits floating formatting to normal editing, modal Cancel/Escape makes no edit and restores owner; Apply commits selection without discarding adjacent formatting. Read-only/replace/unmount invalidate stale actions.
x02KeyApplicability.notApplicable: Native text selection/caret/clipboard/history retain editor semantics; display-only/read-only content is not an editable command surface.

x02KeyApplicability.family: Dialogs, arbitrary Popover forms and Tooltip
x02KeyApplicability.keys: Initial focus enters modal; real Tab/Shift+Tab remain in topmost focus scope. Escape dismisses child before parent and returns each opener. Removed opener recovers parent fallback; successful explicit host focus is not stolen by deferred repair. Tooltip is supplementary description, Escape removes it without moving button focus.
x02KeyApplicability.notApplicable: Tooltip does not own a separate Tab stop; arbitrary Popover form content is not a menu collection.

x02KeyApplicability.family: Civil calendar and segmented time/date entry
x02KeyApplicability.keys: Arrow navigation moves civil-calendar focus; Enter chooses endpoints and applies documented range flow; Escape cancels the popup draft. Segmented time keeps Left/Right segment traversal and Up/Down editing; ordinary text-entry caret keys retain native behavior.
x02KeyApplicability.notApplicable: No timezone/instant or Menu-style typeahead behavior is invented for a civil-date input. Additional calendar-specific shortcuts remain at their documented/tested scope.
